correctness.rationale: The sign is attached to the surviving entry while its magnitude is standardized, and an unknown single output rather than the whole deletion deck is the observation. There are 384 sources and 48 outputs. The prescribed nonnegative twice-weights have multiplicities 12,32,4 and total 40. For nonconstant sign words, the one-, two-, and three-change cases each provide two distinct nonalternating output sign patterns, hence at least two units. For constant signs and a one-output deck, comparing the standardized survivors from deleting adjacent entries of magnitudes a<b at their common position gives a and b-1, so these magnitudes must be consecutive. Repeating this at all three adjacent pairs forces monotone order, whose single output has weight two. A constant-sign deck of size at least two needs no special argument. I independently generated all incidences by inserting every signed absolute rank at every position into each of the 48 outputs, lifting ranks at least the inserted one. All 384 twice-weight constraints held. This inverse enumeration confirmed the printed ten sources and their negatives give 20 distinct sources and 46 distinct outputs with no cross-deck collision; the two omissions are exactly ±(3,-2,1). The integral packing gives a feasible fractional packing of value 20, and the halves of the listed weights provide a dual feasible cover of cost 20. Weak duality certifies both optima exactly.
residual_risks: No classification of all optimum codes; no guarantee for multiple deletion, retained absolute labels, sign errors or higher ranks.

value.rationale: The first balanced sign case makes four ranks a natural baseline: at three every source has a constant-sign output, so just four such outputs cap capacity and the four constant-sign monotone sources attain it. At four a two-plus/two-minus source escapes that bound altogether. An exact benchmark at this onset of mixed-sign shadow packing is useful for evaluating signed deletion constructions and bounds. The half-integral explicit cover and sign-symmetric packing establish not just the number, but exact tightness of a reusable relaxation and attainment with a natural symmetry.
residual_risks: The exact benchmark and symmetry result do not predict the general signed packing capacity or guarantee fractional tightness at higher ranks.
